verdict.rationale: 1Password ships its own programmatic vault surfaces that avoid screen-scraping. The op CLI integrates with the local desktop app and can list vault items. Connect Servers expose items and vaults over a private REST API, and SDKs programmatically read secrets. However, the evidence never shows an agent pulling one-time codes through these surfaces. Connect is framed as infrastructure for company apps rather than a local endpoint for a personal agent, and the Environments MCP server explicitly avoids returning secrets to the agent. Missing for 10: documented retrieval of OTP/2FA codes via CLI/API/SDK, a documented local (desktop-app-backed) endpoint designed for agent queries, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
